description: This file defines the CookieInclusionStatus class, which models whether a cookie is included or excluded during cookie operations, reasons for exclusion, warnings, and related serialization and debugging functions. It also enumerates specific exclusion and warning reasons, and provides methods for managing and inspecting cookie inclusion status.

classes.name: net::CookieInclusionStatus
classes.description: Represents the inclusion or exclusion status of a cookie during get/set operations, including reasons for exclusion and warnings.

methods.name: IsInclude
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is included with no exclusion reasons.

methods.name: HasExclusionReason
methods.description: Checks if a specific exclusion reason is present.

methods.name: ShouldWarn
methods.description: Determines if the cookie should trigger a warning.

methods.name: HasWarningReason
methods.description: Checks if a specific warning reason is present.

methods.name: GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exclusion reasons and warnings for debugging.
